hero.title: A website
hero.text: You are not here by chance. You are in the right place to give your project the visibility it deserves.

2021.title: Initiation and passion
2021.content: Started as a web developer and web development trainer. Discovered my passion for this job, shared experiences and built websites for IT service companies, training centers, blogs, travel and tourism projects. Creation and customization of WordPress themes

2024.title: Freelance and expansion
2024.content: With three years of experience, I worked as a subcontractor for French companies. Solving countless technical problems and bugs. Interventions and creation of simple and complex websites, particularly in real estate, rental investment, and various front-end projects.

2025.title: Experience and versatility
2025.content: Experienced developer, WordPress specialist and pixel-perfect integrator. Interventions in numerous web projects for Malagasy, French and Canadian companies. Collaboration with NGOs, organizations, real estate sectors, women's centers, concierge services and various other fields. Expertise in web performance and technical SEO.

2026.title: Confirmed expertise
2026.content: Always driven by my passion, I continue my activity as a registered freelancer. Having become an expert webmaster, WordPress holds no secrets for me: theme creation and customization, plugin development, web performance optimization and technical SEO. Mastery of Gutenberg, WooCommerce, Elementor, Divi, Avada and many other tools. I have reached about fifty completed projects, confirming my expertise and versatility.
